# Dependency License Texts

Exact package versions, source URLs, declared license expressions and copied notice hashes are in `index.json`. Texts are copied without editing from locally installed, lockfile-resolved packages. npm development-only dependencies are excluded. Cargo includes the complete Windows-filtered dependency closure, including build-time components, conservatively; presence here does not prove runtime inclusion. Existing packages are not relicensed. No local absolute paths or credentials are included.
